column1: # Patch markers — single source of truth for build-time verification.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Each row names a post-patch fingerprint from the patch suite in
# scripts/patches/ (or files staged by app-asar.sh). Both
# verify-patches.sh and tests/verify-patches.bats consume this file,
# so adding a marker here adds it to the runtime check and the test
#   name     — kebab-case id; surfaces in verify output and BATS names.
#   pattern  — PCRE matched against the target file by `grep -P`.
#   sample   — concrete string the pattern matches; BATS uses it to
#              build positive and per-marker negative fixtures.
#   file     — optional target path relative to the asar root
# Markers are hard requirements: if an upstream bump changes the code
# shape so a patch legitimately no longer applies, the build fails
# loudly and the patch must be re-anchored (or the row removed). A
# silent skip is how the #515 duplicate-icon race regressed.
